==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I felt my body in the waking world move and became lucid. I tried to ground myself in the dream by imagining the warmth of fire.
I was in a void with a screen. I could summon what I wanted on the screen, but everywhere else was empty. I couldn't seem to move the screen.
It is odd to be lucid and restricted. I felt conflicted and trapped, like a god imprisoned with a magic tablet.
